baseline: two-step attack/concession CEM bank, four tails, KL 2.5 warm-start cap, six validated proposals
decision: reject all three variants; leave CEM out of default production

variants.hypothesis: Lower CEM warm-start KL to 1.25 to improve held-out variance per work
Spread the same CEM discovery budget over eight tails with one adaptation batch each
Validate four CEM proposals more deeply at fixed validation work rather than six

interpretation: Lower KL, broader targeting, and deeper validation each failed to improve the complete matrix over the original CEM pilot. The four-proposal arm admitted more CEM work but realized fewer ESS>=10 cells, so validation admission and production allocation alone are not evidence of useful variance reduction.
next_research_direction: Change the proposal objective to target second-moment reduction across multiple rare cells, then validate independently. Avoid further tuning of this frontier-distance CEM family without new evidence.
